name: time
description: Time of the reading as exported; local clock, time zone unconfirmed

name: machine
description: TBM number from the directory name

name: stream
description: Directory (and part) the file came from

name: project
description: Project named in the directory; 未标明 when it names none

name: file_status
description: P0 status of the source file

name: source_id
description: Index of the source file in file_audit.csv / source_files.csv

name: row
description: 0-based row number in the source file

name: F
description: Total thrust
source_columns: 总推进力 / 总推力 / 推力

name: T
unit_status: unverified (constant multiple of the drive motors, P0)
description: Cutterhead torque
source_columns: 刀盘转矩 / 刀盘扭矩 / 扭矩

name: n
unit_status: consistent with v/p, absolute unit unconfirmed
description: Cutterhead speed after repair (see n_source)
source_columns: 刀盘速度 / 刀盘实际转速 / 转速

name: v
description: Advance speed
source_columns: 推进速度 / 推进速度(mm/M)

name: p
description: Penetration per revolution
source_columns: 贯入度 / 刀盘贯入度

name: n_raw
description: Cutterhead speed exactly as exported; differs from n only where n_source starts with repaired or is unrecoverable
source_columns: 刀盘速度 / 刀盘实际转速 / 转速

name: n_source
description: exported, repaired_v_over_p, repaired_drive_speed, unrecoverable or missing

name: state_boring
description: The machine's own boring flag (TBM8: advance state); empty where the export has none
source_columns: 掘进状态 / 推进状态

name: state_cutter
description: Cutterhead working state code

name: state_thrust
description: Thrust working state code

name: state_regrip
description: Re-gripping state

name: chainage
description: Guide shield head chainage; zero and near-zero readings are NaN

name: ring
description: Guide boring ring count; zero readings are NaN

name: cutter_mileage
description: Cutterhead mileage of TBM1 to TBM6 (offset by about 735,000 on TBM5 and TBM6); zero readings are NaN

name: drive_speed_med
description: Median speed (TBM1-TBM6) or frequency (others) over the drive motors that read above zero
source_columns: 主驱动电机i速度 / Mi电机频率 / i#电机输出频率

name: drive_torque_med
description: Median torque over the drive motors that read above zero
source_columns: 主驱动电机i扭矩 / Mi电机扭矩 / i#电机扭矩

name: drive_motors_on
description: Drive motors reading above zero

name: dt_prev_s
description: Seconds since the previous reading of the machine

name: active
description: F, T, n and v all above zero

name: valid_core
description: No hard flag: not q_neg, q_core_missing, q_v_high, q_T_high, q_F_high, q_v_invalid_file or q_time_conflict

name: q_time_backward
description: Time is earlier than the previous row of the file

name: q_time_coarse
description: File has timestamps only to the minute (P0)

name: q_time_conflict
description: Another reading of the machine has the same timestamp and different values

name: q_neg
description: A core signal is negative

name: q_core_missing
description: F, T, n or v is empty (also where the export has no such column)

name: q_n_invalid
description: Exported n is not a rotation speed (above the rpm limit, or as large as the drive-motor speed)

name: q_v_high
description: v above 250 mm/min

name: q_T_high
description: T above 12000

name: q_F_high
description: F above 60000

name: q_pnv_off
description: p*n/v outside 0.5 to 2 where v, p and n are large enough to be read

name: q_v_invalid_file
description: P0 found v and p of the whole file unusable

name: q_counter_glitch
description: A position counter is off its level at the start of the file (jumps found in P0)
